answer.summary: A new, narrow research question is proposed to investigate explicit mechanisms of memory retrieval under contextual perturbations in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, focusing on retrieval fidelity and latency under known disruptions.
answer.content: Investigate whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 reports explicit mechanisms for memory retrieval under contextual perturbations, including defined conditions under which retrieval fidelity or latency is measured and reported as a function of input disruption magnitude or timing. If such mechanisms are absent, propose a minimal operational definition of retrieval-based memory integrity as an anchor for comparative evaluation.

answer.lesson: Memory superiority claims require explicit, verifiable mechanisms under defined perturbation conditions; absence of such mechanisms invalidates state coherence assertions without alternative anchoring metrics for evaluation.
